`@interface UIStoreData`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.hook.store` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIStoreData.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/hook/store/UIStoreData.java)

Annotation that gives a store its scope and the name of its file.

## Description

Every [`UIStore`](/reference/ui/uistore/) subclass needs it.

## Learn more

- [Stores and properties](/use/learn/state/stores-and-properties/#choose-where-a-value-lives)
- [Build a settings screen](/use/guides/build-a-settings-screen/)
- [Save the settings](/use/tutorial/settings/)

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `String` | [id](#UIStoreData-element-id) | `""` | Name of the file of a `PERMANENT` store, `store/<id>.store` in the data folder; empty uses the full name of the class. |
| [`UIStoreScope`](/reference/ui/uistorescope/) | [scope](#UIStoreData-element-scope) | `UIStoreScope.LOCAL` | How long the store lives and who shares it. |

## Element details

<a id="UIStoreData-element-id"></a>

### id

`String id() default ""` 

Name of the file of a `PERMANENT` store, `store/<id>.store` in the data folder; empty uses the full name of the class.

<a id="UIStoreData-element-scope"></a>

### scope

`UIStoreScope scope() default UIStoreScope.LOCAL` 

How long the store lives and who shares it.
